program: SYM-02 - Threshold K Exact Vector Shape Refinement
director_authority: C0 Threshold K selected as provisional primary-symbol incumbent; exact C0 remains immutable control.
bounded_question: Can the selected Threshold K be given more deliberate exact vector contour construction without changing its three-field topology, spacing architecture, mass hierarchy, or discovered-in-the-void K?
prior_evidence: Drive: Kymaean Lane B — Threshold K Controlled Refinement 01: spacing, gentler waist and reduced-left-mass variants did not advance; contour simplification retained only as an implementation hypothesis.
Drive: Kymaean Lane B — Threshold K Context Deployment 01: mark needs breathing room more than layout-driven geometric correction.

round_01_variables.C1: Bezier fidelity: replace trace-like segmented contour with smooth cubic construction while preserving extents and architecture.
round_01_variables.C2: Tangent discipline: tighten continuity/tension of the same smooth construction, preserving extents and architecture.
round_01_variables.C3: Terminal discipline: refine only terminal transitions/tips on the smooth construction while preserving negative-space architecture.

success_criteria: K remains discovered in negative space rather than drawn
right field remains dominant but not glyph-like
16/20/24 px recognition does not regress versus C0
large-scale contour feels deliberately authored rather than raster-traced
no candidate becomes a conventional K, bracket, chevron, play/arrow or generic tech mark
